triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER payout_profile_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION payout_profile_delete_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER people075_profile_insert BEFORE INSERT ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION people075_profile_insert()
CREATE TRIGGER people_profile_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION people_profile_delete_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER people_profile_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION people_profile_update_guard()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_finance_billable_charge_permission_fields BEFORE UPDATE OF can_view_finance_billable_charges, can_manage_finance_billable_charges, can_approve_finance_billable_charges ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_finance_billable_charge_permission_fields()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_finance_cash_permission_fields BEFORE UPDATE OF can_view_finance_cash_transactions, can_manage_finance_cash_transactions, can_confirm_finance_cash_transactions, can_reverse_finance_cash_transactions ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_finance_cash_permission_fields()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_finance_payment_permission_fields BEFORE UPDATE OF can_manage_finance_payments, can_confirm_finance_payments, can_reverse_finance_payments, can_reallocate_finance_payments ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_finance_payment_permission_fields()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_finance_receipt_permission_fields BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF can_view_finance_receipts, can_manage_finance_receipts, can_issue_finance_receipts, can_void_finance_receipts ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_finance_receipt_permission_fields()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_finance_tax_invoice_permissions BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF can_view_finance_tax_invoices, can_manage_finance_tax_invoices, can_issue_finance_tax_invoices ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_finance_tax_invoice_permissions()

policies.name: active assistant lawyer up can insert advisory issues
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text, 'lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text])))))

policies.name: active assistant lawyer up can update advisory issues
policies.check:
((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text, 'lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text]))))))
policies.using:
((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text, 'lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text]))))))

policies.name: active partner up can restore advisory issues
policies.check:
((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text]))))))
policies.using:
((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text]))))))

policies.name: active partner up can soft delete advisory issues
policies.check:
((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text]))))))
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles up
  WHERE ((up.id = auth.uid()) AND (up.active = true) AND (up.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text])))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin074_session_allowed()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select not exists(select 1 from public.user_profiles where id=auth.uid() and role='admin' and active is not true);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.jwt()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
    coalesce(
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim', true), ''),
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')
    )::jsonb
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_create_advisory_matter()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.user_profiles up
    where up.id = auth.uid() and up.active = true
      and up.role in ('admin', 'partner', 'lawyer', 'assistant_lawyer')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_audit_logs()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_profiles up
    where up.id = auth.uid()
      and up.active = true
      and up.role in ('admin', 'partner', 'lawyer')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_advisory_matter_no()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_year integer;
  next_number integer;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or public.can_create_advisory_matter() is distinct from true then
    raise exception 'ADVISORY_CREATE_PERMISSION_DENIED' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  current_year := extract(year from now())::integer;
  insert into public.advisory_matter_counters
    (year, last_number, updated_at)
  values
    (current_year, 1, now())
  on conflict (year)
  do update
    set last_number =
      public.advisory_matter_counters.last_number + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  returning last_number into next_number;
  return
    'ADV-' ||
    current_year::text ||
    '-' ||
    lpad(next_number::text, 3, '0');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people_is_active_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.user_profiles where id=auth.uid() and active is true and role='admin');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people_is_assignable(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.user_profiles where id=p_id and active is true and account_type='operational' and assignable);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people_profile_delete_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if pg_trigger_depth()<2 or current_setting('people.delete_target',true) is distinct from old.id::text
 then raise exception 'Use the guarded Auth deletion operation'; end if;
 return old;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people075_profile_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 new.must_change_password:=exists(select 1 from auth.users a where a.id=new.id and nullif(a.raw_app_meta_data->>'vp_temporary_password_nonce','') is not null);
 return new;
end; $function$
